name: Tic-Tac-Toe
description: Interactive floating Tic-Tac-Toe mini-game with local 2-Player mode and intelligent AI opponent.
longDescription:
Bring playful entertainment into your PDF workflow! Features single player vs AI (with Easy, Smart, and Unbeatable difficulties) and local 2-player pass-and-play mode. Deeply integrated with FryPDF shell overlay, status bar, and command palette.

### Key Features:
• **Floating Shell Overlay**: Smoothly drags and docks on top of any document workspace.
• **Single Player vs Smart AI**: Multiple difficulty settings with strategic minimax moves.
• **Local 2-Player Mode**: Play head-to-head with friends or colleagues.
• **Score Counter**: Live score tracking for wins, losses, and draws.
• **Deep Shell Integration**: Contributes to Command Palette (), Status Bar (), and Ribbon View Tab.
contributedFeatures: Shell Overlay: Floating Tic-Tac-Toe Game Card
Status Bar: Clickable '🎮 Tic-Tac-Toe' Indicator Pill
Ribbon: View Tab > Plugins > Tic-Tac-Toe Action Button
